---
title: "Typst: px image sizes are converted when the image has alt text"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      # Leaked px, unsupported units, and unresolved paths must not compile.
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # Inline fig-alt keeps its alt and converts 200px to 200/96 inches.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Inline fig-alt")(?=[^)]*height: 2\.08333\d*in)'
          # Explicit alt survives alongside the converted 30px width.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Inline alt")(?=[^)]*width: 0\.3125\d*in)'
          # An inline caption supplies alt when no alt attribute is present.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Caption as alt")(?=[^)]*height: 0\.20833\d*in)'
          # A captioned figure uses fig-alt, not its visible caption.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Figure fig-alt")(?=[^)]*height: 0\.20833\d*in)'
          # Cross-referenced figures also retain fig-alt and converted size.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Crossref fig-alt")(?=[^)]*height: 0\.20833\d*in)'
          # The encoded source path becomes a usable filename without losing alt.
          - 'image\("my image\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Encoded path")'
          # Unsupported 3vw width is omitted while the image and alt remain.
          - 'image\("penrose\.svg",\s*alt:\s*"Unknown unit"\)'
        -
          # No image may retain an unconverted integer px dimension.
          - 'image\([^)]*\d+px'
          # A URL-encoded path must not appear in Typst output.
          - 'my%20image'
          # Typst cannot accept the unsupported vw dimension.
          - '3vw'
---

Inline with fig-alt: ![](penrose.svg){height="200px" fig-alt="Inline fig-alt"}

Inline with alt: ![](penrose.svg){width="30px" alt="Inline alt"}

Inline with caption: text ![Caption as alt](penrose.svg){height="20px"} text

Encoded path: ![](my%20image.svg){alt="Encoded path"}

Unknown unit: ![](penrose.svg){width="3vw" alt="Unknown unit"}

![Figure caption](penrose.svg){height="20px" fig-alt="Figure fig-alt"}

![Crossref caption](penrose.svg){#fig-penrose height="20px" fig-alt="Crossref fig-alt"}
